messages:
Zoe (devex): Quick sync: planning a staged SDK publish (py + ts) tomorrow 11:00 PT. Scope: remove legacy sync client, ship compat-shim, include deprecation notice & migration snippet. Staggered rollout and explicit dist-tag plan.

Marco (sdk): Noted. Last canary showed intermittent signature warnings on some wheels. Strong preference to rotate signing key in CI before GA.

Pri (release): We need exact dist-tag commands and a grace/yank policy so support and SRE teams can act fast. Also who owns the release note wording?

Zoe (devex): Proposed plan:
1) Publish py wheel to `next` at 11:00 -> 30m watch.
2) If stable, publish ts package to `next` at 11:40 -> 2h canary.
3) After 48h of no regressions, promote `next` -> `latest`.
4) Keep `legacy-sync` dist-tag for 72h then rm.
Rollback triggers: signature errors, >1% install failures in 1h, or >10 customer reports in 3h.

Jared (oncall): For alerting: set threshold 0.7% for first 45m, then 1.5% for the remainder of the canary. I'll prepare a temporary alarm and an on-call runbook entry.

Marco (sdk): Key rotation steps I'll run now and include in CI preflight:
```
gpg --import new-signing-key.asc
export SIGN_KEY=new-key-id
ci/publish --sign-with ${SIGN_KEY}
```
Expect ~12m for rotation + sign verification.

CI Bot: canary preflight: smoke tests 6/6 passed, sign-check: warning (found legacy key in CI env)

Pri (release): Dist-tag commands for docs/comms:
```
# canary
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdks@4.0.0 next
# promote to latest
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdks@4.0.0 latest
# rollback example
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdks@3.9.8 latest
# remove legacy tag
npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdks legacy-sync
```
For pip, advise `pip install redwood-sdk==3.9.8` to pin. We'll include these in support KB.

Clara (docs): I'll draft the deprecation paragraph and a migration snippet (shim usage + example). Drop copy in this thread by EOD. Who signs off text? Product or release?

Zoe (devex): Product will quick-approve; I can shepherd the copy. Also add a short note in release notes about the dist-tag procedure and rollback criteria.

Jared (oncall): I'll run the dist-tag rollback runbook in a dry-run today so the team is familiar. Also preparing an incident template for quick status updates if we need to roll back.

Marco (sdk): After CI key rotate I'll re-run sign-check and post logs. If sign-check still warns, hold all promotions and do not change `latest`.

Publish Bot: scheduled publish window reserved: 2026-04-22T18:00:00Z. Auto-blockers: sign-check warnings, failing smoke tests.

Zoe (devex): Everyone please react :thumbsup: once you've acked. We'll proceed with the staggered schedule unless something blocks the preflight. Tag @oncall + @release for any urgent updates in-thread.

Pri (release): Acknowledged.

Clara (docs): Ack, I'll post copy later.

Marco (sdk): Ack, running rotation now.

Jared (oncall): Ack, will standby for alerts.

CI Bot: reminder scheduled: 2026-04-22T17:45:00Z - preflight check in 15m

Zoe (devex): Thanks team — if anything unexpected, post here immediately. Otherwise we follow the staged rollout and dist-tag policy above. :rocket:
